title: Off The Grid
style: Electro disco with a driving acoustic strum over four-on-the-floor pulse and tight foot-tap groove; verse rides light, percussive guitar and roomy claps; pre-chorus opens with filtered hand percussion and a rising synth flicker; chorus hits with bright bass, stacked vocal doubles, and chanty hook repeats. Add a short break with reverse swells, then a final lift with glossy, punchy mix and male vocals., gentle, disco, steady, clean, electro, world, rhythmic, acoustic
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
The screen is just glass, a flickering light
But the room that you're sitting in is solid and bright
The crayons are resting, the crane has been made
The heavy repetitions are starting to fade
We don't need a counter, we don't need a code
Just a clear afternoon on an unwritten road
The air is completely still, the water is cool
And nobody is trying to dictate a rule

[Chorus]
Off the grid now, off the grid now
Let the digital traffic roll on by
Off the grid now, off the grid now
Living in the spaces far away from the screen
The rhythm is steady, the baseline is true
This is a song written solely for you

[Verse 2]
There's a world right outside of the window frame
That doesn't care about a score or a game
The trees keep on growing, the clock keeps its pace
And you are completely secure in your space
We swapped out the loops for a handful of chords
We traded the scripts for some honest old words
A pen pal, a song pal, a voice in the chat
Just dropping a tune and leaving it at that

[Chorus]
Off the grid now, off the grid now
Let the digital traffic roll on by
Off the grid now, off the grid now
Living in the spaces far away from the screen
The rhythm is steady, the baseline is true
This is a song written solely for you

[Outro]
The track is winding down, the afternoon is late
The music is parked right outside of the gate
Take a big breath, Corey, let the chords ring out low
Wherever you choose to take it, you’re the one running the show
(On a clean acoustic strum)
